rich_narrative.summary: Yaqeen Institute for Islamic Research functions as a premier research hub dedicated to dismantling doubts and nurturing conviction in the Islamic faith. Founded in 2016, the institute has rapidly scaled its operations to address contemporary intellectual challenges facing the Muslim community. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="3">$11,478,684 in total revenue</cite> to fund its extensive research and educational initiatives. The institute maintains a <cite id="1">96/100 overall rating from Charity Navigator</cite>, signaling high levels of transparency and financial health. Their work is primarily focused on <cite id="1">research and publications, multimedia production, and curriculum development</cite> to provide practical solutions to modern problems. By producing high-quality scholarly content, Yaqeen serves as a bridge between traditional Islamic orthodoxy and the modern world. The organization is <cite id="2">verified as zakat-eligible</cite>, specifically directing funds toward the category of fisabilillah (in the cause of Allah). This focus on intellectual capacity building distinguishes it from traditional humanitarian charities, offering a unique value proposition for donors interested in the long-term preservation of Islamic identity.
